title: GlobalBench: A Benchmark for Global Progress in Natural Language Processing
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on NLP system performance, utility, and equity across different languages and speaker populations.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
